jobs.description:
Lead the design, development, and optimization of enterprise applications across back-end and front-end technologies. Architect scalable solutions, apply advanced software design patterns, and mentor junior and medior developers. Utilize the Microsoft ecosystem, modern front-end frameworks, Azure cloud services, messaging platforms, and architectural practices like CQRS, DDD, and Clean Architecture to deliver robust and business-aligned solutions.
Key responsibilities

• Architect and design scalable enterprise applications

• Implement and enforce advanced software patterns (CQRS, DDD, Clean Architecture)

• Design, implement, and maintain MicroServices-based architectures

• Develop clean, secure, and maintainable code across front-end and back-end

• Mentor and coach junior and medior developers, perform code reviews

• Build interactive user interfaces with modern front-end frameworks (Angular, Blazor, React)

• Collaborate with product owners and business analysts to translate requirements into technical solutions

• Implement and optimize containerized solutions with Kubernetes, Docker, or AKS

• Design and integrate distributed systems using messaging Middleware (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, Kafka)

• Leverage Azure services for cloud-native, scalable, and secure solutions

• C#

• .NET Core

• ASP.NET Core

• Entity Framework Core

• LINQ

• RESTful API design and integration

• SQL Server

• MicroServices architecture

• CQRS

• DDD

• Clean Architecture principles

• Blazor or Angular

• TypeScript

• JavaScript

• Unit & integration testing

• CI/CD pipelines

• Microsoft Azure

• Kubernetes

• Docker

• AKS

• WPF (XAML) is a plus

• Problem-solving

• Rigorous methodology

Qualifications

• 5+ years in .NET / .NET Core development

• Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field is a plus

• English + French and / or Dutch

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.

• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

jobs.occupation: Become a Wheel Loader or Forklift Operator for a Recycling Company – Environmentally Conscious Job i
jobs.description:
Are you skilled with a wheel loader or forklift and looking for a varied job in the recycling sector? This position as a wheel loader/forklift operator is perfect for you. You’ll help recycle plastic waste and contribute to a better environment. Your main tasks include moving plastic waste, handling big bags, and safely loading and unloading trucks.

On a typical workday, you’ll start with a short briefing before you begin moving waste streams around the site. You work accurately and ensure everything ends up in the right place. Sometimes the waste can have an odor, but thanks to your dedication, the site stays orderly and safe. You’ll follow a unique work schedule: 4 weeks working in Lanaken, followed by 4 weeks off at home in Poland.

Do you have a valid certificate and speak English or Polish? Apply now! You’ll receive a great salary, meal vouchers, and the possibility to extend your contract. We’re looking for motivated people who want to help build a more sustainable world.

• Possession of a forklift operator or wheel loader operator certificate

• Good command of English or Polish, both spoken and written

• Minimum diploma of higher secondary education

• Experience operating a wheel loader, forklift, or crane is a plus

• Flexibility to work in a 4-weeks-on, 4-weeks-off system

• Safety minded and orderly work habits

• Open to junior, medior, and senior candidates

jobs.occupation: Experienced Vehicle Technician Wanted – Automotive Maintenance Specialist Rumst
jobs.description:
As a vehicle technician, you are responsible for the maintenance and repair of passenger cars and light commercial vehicles of all makes. You will work in a spacious, modern body shop known for its craftsmanship and customer focus. The workshop specializes in both conventional and electric/hybrid vehicles, so you'll work with the latest automotive technologies.

On a typical day, you’ll independently carry out both minor and major maintenance services. You diagnose technical issues using state-of-the-art diagnostic tools and perform mechanical, electrical, and electronic repairs. Quality is key, and you ensure every vehicle leaves the workshop in top condition.

Are you a precise, self-reliant technician with a passion for cars? Apply now and become part of a dedicated team. Together, you’ll ensure satisfied customers and vehicles in perfect working order.

• Diploma in automotive technology at secondary education level or equivalent through experience

• At least 1 to 2 years of relevant experience as a car technician

• Knowledge of modern diagnostic tools and systems

• Able to work independently and accurately

• Proficient in English, both spoken and written

• Holder of a valid category B driver’s license

• Passion for vehicles and new technologies

jobs.occupation: Become a Bodywork Assembler (m/f/x) for an Innovative Body Shop Department in Rumst
jobs.description:
As a Bodywork Assembler, you are responsible for disassembling and assembling vehicles as part of body repairs. You will work daily on both traditional and electric vehicles, paying extra attention to safety and precision, especially with electric systems. You follow established procedures and collaborate with colleagues to deliver the best results for every customer.

On a typical workday, you'll start by reviewing the scheduled repairs. You remove and install parts like bumpers, lighting, and other bodywork components. You regularly work on electric vehicles, strictly following the safety guidelines for high voltage and battery systems. Close collaboration with painters and panel beaters is essential to ensure smooth workflow and top quality. After assembly, you conduct thorough quality control.

Can you see yourself working in an innovative environment with the latest technologies and infrastructure? Apply now and join a team that values quality, innovation, and teamwork.

• At least 1 to 2 years of experience as a bodywork assembler, disassembler, or technician in a body shop environment

• Knowledge of electric vehicles, including batteries and high-voltage components

• Able to work accurately, structured, and independently

• Good command of spoken and written English

• Holder of a valid category B driver's license

• Diploma of higher secondary education or equivalent through experience

jobs.occupation: Weekend Production Operator – Flexible Schedule, Attractive Pay, and Career Growth
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a rewarding and well-paid temporary opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a modern production environment? As a Weekend Production Operator, you will play a key role in ensuring smooth and efficient operations for a well-respected company in Kaulille. This temporary role runs from July through September and is ideal for individuals who are available and motivated to work long weekend shifts.

Your typical day involves operating and monitoring state-of-the-art machines, conducting quality checks, and maintaining strict hygiene and safety standards. You'll rotate between day and night shifts: one week you'll work from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and the following week from 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM. You will also be responsible for cleaning equipment, applying HACCP procedures, and stepping in wherever needed on the production floor to support your team.

If you enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and you're looking to boost your income over the summer, this is the role for you. Apply now to join a team where your reliability and technical insight are valued, and where there’s potential for a long-term position based on your performance!

• Commitment to work weekends for the full 3-month period (July–September)
• Availability for both day (6:00 AM–6:00 PM) and night (6:00 PM–6:00 AM) shifts on a rotating basis
• Good command of English or Dutch
• Technical insight or an affinity for technical work
• Ability to work accurately, hygienically, and safely
• Suitable for candidates not in full-time weekday employment

Are you ready to take your skills to the next level as a Die Cutting Machine Operator? We're looking for someone like you to join our dynamic team. You'll set up and operate cutting-edge machinery in a fast-paced environment, ensuring precision and quality in every product.

In this role, you'll start your day by setting up the die cutter based on order specifications. Your keen eye for detail will ensure everything is in its right place, from adjusting feeder plates to installing dies. You'll work across two shifts, maintaining high standards of quality and efficiency to meet production goals.

Ready to make your mark in an industry-leading company? Apply today and become part of a team that values precision, quality, and innovation.

• Minimum of 2 years experience as a Die Cutting Machine Operator

• Technical knowledge, gained through studies or practical experience

• Communicative knowledge of English

• Affinity with technology and attention to detail

• Willingness to work two shifts: 1st shift from Monday to Thursday, 5:15 to 13:15, and Friday, 5:00 to 13:00; 2nd shift from Monday to Thursday, 13:15 to 21:15, and Friday, 11:00 to 17:00

jobs.occupation: Business Developement Manager - EV Infrastructure - Belgium
jobs.description:
Our client is a fast-growing company accelerating the transition towards more sustainable transportation infrastructure.

To support its continued growth, we are looking for a commercially driven Business Development Manager who thrives on opening new doors, building relationships, and closing deals.

This opportunity is ideal for a true sales hunter who enjoys creating opportunities from scratch while managing a mix of short and long sales cycles.

Jobomschrijving

Business Development & Prospecting

• Proactively identify and target new business opportunities across Belgium.
• Build and maintain a strong pipeline through outbound prospecting, networking, referrals, and market intelligence.
• Generate meetings with prospective partners through phone, email, LinkedIn outreach, and face-to-face interactions.
• Develop creative approaches to access key decision-makers and create new business opportunities.
End-to-End Sales Management

• Manage the complete sales cycle from first contact to signed agreement.
• Lead commercial discussions, presentations, negotiations, and closing activities.
• Successfully manage both fast-moving transactional opportunities and more strategic, longer-term deals.
• Maintain accurate reporting and pipeline forecasting.
Relationship Building

• Develop trusted relationships with business owners, real estate stakeholders, corporate decision-makers, and senior executives.
• Understand client needs and position tailored partnership solutions.
• Identify opportunities to grow existing partnerships and expand commercial relationships.
Market Development

• Monitor market trends and identify emerging opportunities.
• Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and networking activities.
• Share market intelligence and competitive insights with the wider business.

• At least a first experience in Business Development, Sales, Account Management, Partnership Development, or a similar commercial role.
• Demonstrated success in prospecting and acquiring new clients or partners.
• Experience managing different types of sales cycles, from relatively short transactional opportunities to more complex consultative sales processes.
• Strong negotiation and communication skills.
• Highly resilient, results-oriented, and motivated by achieving targets.
• Comfortable operating autonomously while contributing to a collaborative team environment.
• Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive attitude and strong sense of ownership.
• Fluent in French, English, Dutch

Do you speak English very well and are you looking for a flexible administrative job where the work-life balance is highly important? Then you are perfectly suited for the international and renowned company we are looking for.

You will be responsible for opening and processing insurance claim files. You will also be in charge of handling damage payments and other insurance-related inquiries. Additionally, you will stay in contact with clients (via phone or email) for any missing or additional information.

You will be part of an international and friendly team where you can always rely on your colleagues and team leader, while also having the necessary independence.
-Excellent English language skills.
-Dutch is not required, but a plus. 
-Ability to work in a structured manner.
-A first experience in administration or equivalent by diploma.

Our client is an international B2B sales organization, operating within different sectors. 
In Belgium, the company has a strong entrepreneurial spirit, focusing on direct sales of professional products and solutions to end users (B2B construction companies).
 
The organization combines the stability of a large group with the agility of a local entity.

Jobomschrijving

As an Area Sales Manager, your main responsibilities will be to:

• Lead and manage a team of around 10 Account Managers (mix of junior and senior profiles)
• Act as coach, and inspiration source for the team
• Strong focus on coaching in the field 
• Provide continuous feedback and translate strategy into concrete actions
• Focus on Flemish Brabant area
• Drive commercial growth while ensuring profitability and long-term relationships
• Stay close to the business
• Maintain contact with key accounts and step in when needed
• Report directly to the Sales Director

The successful candidate will have the following qualities:

• At least 5 years of commercial experience
• Proven experience in managing teams
• Strong sales mindset 
• Experience in B2B direct sales environments
• Affinity with construction sector is a plus
• Strong coaching capabilities
• Resilient, ambitious, transparent, and hands-on
• Analytical, structured, and result-oriented
• Excellent communication skills
• Fluent in Dutch, English - French is a strong asset

jobs.occupation: ECommerce specialist - Waals Brabant - Dutch speaker
jobs.description:
Join a fast-growing international retail group operating across several European markets. With a strong omnichannel model combining an extensive physical store network with high-performing e-commerce platforms, the company is experiencing continued growth and digital transformation. Customer experience, innovation and operational excellence are at the heart of its strategy.

Jobomschrijving

This is a hands-on operational role for someone who likes to be at the heart of the action: monitoring online performance, solving issues, coordinating with different teams and making sure customers enjoy a smooth journey from click to delivery.

You will act as a key point of contact between E-commerce, IT, Customer Service, Logistics and external partners, ensuring that the online business runs efficiently every day.

Your Responsibilities

• Monitor the daily performance of the e-commerce platforms and key operational KPIs, identifying opportunities and potential issues.
• Ensure a smooth and reliable online customer journey, from website navigation and checkout to payment and delivery.
• Investigate and resolve operational issues, proactively identifying root causes and coordinating corrective actions.
• Act as the operational bridge between E-commerce, IT, Customer Service, Logistics, Project teams and external partners.
• Follow up on payment, delivery and order-related processes, ensuring issues are addressed quickly and efficiently.
• Coordinate the management of incidents and technical issues, prioritising them according to their impact on customers and the business.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of e-commerce processes, tools and ways of working.
• Analyse performance and operational data to identify trends, recurring issues and areas for improvement.
• Support the implementation of new e-commerce initiatives, projects and system enhancements.
• Ensure a high level of data accuracy, operational quality and customer satisfaction across the online channel.

• You have 2-5 years of experience in e-commerce operations, digital operations, online retail or a similar hands-on environment.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English; Dutch is mandatory for the role. French is a strong plus.
• You have a strong operational mindset and enjoy getting into the details to understand and solve problems.
• You are analytical, structured and solution-oriented, with a natural ability to prioritise.
• You are comfortable working cross-functionally and coordinating with multiple stakeholders.
• You don't wait for problems to solve themselves: you are proactive, hands-on and pragmatic.
• You have a genuine interest in retail, e-commerce and customer experience.
• Experience with e-commerce platforms, order management systems, payment solutions, ticketing tools or analytics platforms is a plus.

Planning Management:

• Process and monitor information related to incoming goods received via email; manage the inbound mailbox.

• Maintain oversight of delivery schedules, slot bookings, and warehouse capacity utilization.

Continuous Improvement:

• Resolve issues related to transportation, goods, and materials.
• Act as the communication link between Customer Service, Operations, and Carriers.
• Analyze and follow up on transportation claims in C4C.

• Good command of Dutch and English, both written and spoken.

Together with functional experts, scrum masters, UX designers and other developers, you will work in an inspiring, high-paced and fun environment. We work on software projects according to the agile methodology (SCRUM) and in close collaboration with our customers.
Role
As a Java developer your input will help shape the future of the company, we will count on you to coach other developers and steer our approach for various projects. You are able to work closely together with the business, willing to go the extra mile and love to tackle new challenges. You get excited about new technologies and are always eager to learn more.

Profile
• You have at least 3 years of relevant experience in any of the following technologies: Java, Spring Boot framework, NodeJS, designing and implementing RESTful API’s

For an internationally active company specialized in automated warehouse systems and logistics automation, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Automation Technician / PLC Technician to join the permanent night shift team.
 

You will ensure that highly automated warehouse and logistics systems continue to operate efficiently and reliably.
 

As an Automation Technician, you will be responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of automated installations.
 

Your responsibilities:
 

 
• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on complex automated installations.
 
• Diagnosing and resolving technical faults and breakdowns.
 
• Troubleshooting issues in electrical, mechanical and automated systems.
 
• Working with PLC controls, sensors, motors and SCADA systems.
 
• Ensuring that automated warehouse installations operate safely and efficiently.
 
• Carrying out technical interventions independently and identifying the root cause of malfunctions.
 
• Recording maintenance activities and interventions correctly in the CMMS system (Sprocket).
 
• Working independently during the permanent night shift, while consulting colleagues when necessary.
 
• Contributing to the safety, reliability and efficiency of the installations. 

 
• A technical degree in electromechanics, electricity, automation and/or mechanics.
 
• Several years of experience as an Automation Technician, Maintenance Technician, Service Technician, Troubleshooting Technician or PLC Technician.
 
• Basic knowledge of industrial automation and PLC systems.
 
• Knowledge of sensors, motors, electrical components and technical installations.
 
• Experience with or an interest in SCADA and CMMS systems.
 
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 
• A proactive, independent and accurate working attitude.
 
• A good command of Dutch and/or English.
 
• No fear of heights, as you may work at different levels within the automated installations.
 
• Good physical fitness.
 
• A strong interest in technology and a willingness to continue learning.
 
• The flexibility and motivation to work in 2 shifts
